title: Brian Burns to have MRI on knee

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brian Burns to have MRI on knee
sources.description: Giants defensive end Brian Burns was expected to miss Sunday's game against the Titans with an ankle injury, but he was able to play long enough to suffer another injury.
